### gratituous ARP requests  {.smaller}


* solution: send <i>unsolicited</i> ARP messages 
<hr class="vspace" />
* CC:…:01$\rightarrow$FF:…:FF: request: who has 10.0.2.9, tell 10.0.2.9=CC:…:01  
<hr class="vspace" />
* request not reply b/c concerns about old/broken implementations 

   * ICMPv6 ND fixes this: <br> message is ‘advertisement’ ($\sim$ reply), not ‘solicitation’ ($\sim$ request)

### duplicate addresses  {.smaller}


* recommendations in RFC 5227 [ ‘‘IPv4 Address Conflict Detection’’]{.my-small} 
<hr class="vspace" />
* probe for IP address before using it 

   * make sure to broadcast when starting to use address
   * probably give up on address if conflict found

* watch out for ARP messages indicating address in use
* on detecting conflict choose between: 

   * ‘defend’ address with more gratituous requests
   * give up address
